name: nexus-monorepo
description: Repository-level orchestration for the Nexus applications

scripts.build:contracts: npm run build --workspace=@nexus/character-contracts && npm run build --workspace=@nexus/document-contracts
scripts.build:vtt: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:all --workspace=nexus-vtt
scripts.build:forge: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace=nexus-forge
scripts.build:codex: npm run build:contracts && npm run prisma:generate --workspace=nexus-codex-doc-api && npm run build --workspace=nexus-codex-doc-api && npm run prisma:generate --workspace=nexus-codex-doc-processor && npm run build --workspace=nexus-codex-doc-processor && npm run prisma:generate --workspace=nexus-codex-doc-websocket && npm run build --workspace=nexus-codex-doc-websocket && npm run build --workspace=admin-ui && npm run build --workspace=@nexuscodex/dm-ui && npm run build --workspace=docs
scripts.type-check: npm run build:contracts && npm run type-check --workspace=nexus-vtt && npm exec --workspace=nexus-forge tsc -- --noEmit && npm run build:codex
scripts.test:forge: npm --prefix apps/forge run lint && npm --prefix apps/forge run test -- --run --coverage
scripts.test:codex: npm --prefix apps/codex/services/doc-api test -- --runInBand src/services/__tests__/processing-quality.service.test.ts && npm --prefix apps/codex/services/doc-processor test -- --runInBand && npm --prefix apps/codex/services/doc-websocket test -- --runInBand --passWithNoTests && npm --prefix apps/codex/docs run typecheck
